subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — Enterprise Bank
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@enterprisebank.com>, Tom Reid <tom.reid@enterprisebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — Enterprise Bank

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed 4-week POC plan so you have something concrete to review and share with the team.

Key needs we heard from the call:
- Real-time customer support routing use case (multi-turn chat) with strict latency and cost targets
- On-prem/Private deployment requirement for production later in the project
- Data privacy + ability to redact PII before persistent storage
- Evaluation focused on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) performance on a 6-month support ticket corpus

Proposed POC goals (4 weeks):
1) Setup & access (Week 1) — private test environment, SSO access for two engineers, initial sample data upload
2) Baseline evaluation (Week 2) — run baseline models, collect latency/cost/quality metrics on an agreed prompt set
3) Optimization (Week 3) — apply caching/batching/quantization recommendations, iterate prompts, tune retrieval layer
4) Final evaluation & handoff (Week 4) — run final evals, share report with success criteria and recommended next steps

Proposed success criteria (suggested) — happy to finalize with you:
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end response time < 350 ms for standard chat flows
- Quality: F1 on entity extraction and 80% pass-rate on representative QA prompts (we'll provide exact evals)
- Cost: token cost reduction target compared to current baseline (we'll capture units in the evaluation workbook)
- Security: SSO + KMS integration validated in test environment, no persisted raw PII in Redwood-managed storage

Owners (Redwood / Enterprise Bank):
- Redwood: Camila (point of contact, project coordination), Marissa (Solutions lead), Dylan (SRE / infra)
- Enterprise Bank: Sarah (product), Tom (engineering) — please confirm if we should add procurement/legal contacts now

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft scope & timeline), Evaluation_Criteria.xlsx (prompt sets + metrics)

Next steps
- Please confirm the success criteria and proposed timeline by Friday so we can lock resources.
- If you want us to start the SSO/KMS checklist ahead of time, we can send the Integration_Checklist doc and a short technical kickoff invite.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Camila — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. A few quick notes from our side after syncing with Tom this morning: 

- The success criteria look good. Two items to add: 1) ability to integrate with our existing SSO (Azure AD) and 2) ability to use our KMS for key management during the POC (we can provide temporary creds for the test env).
- We need to confirm data sampling limits — legal is only comfortable with a de-identified 2500-ticket sample to start. Can your team run the evals on that subset?
- For quality, can you include at least one precision/recall metric for entity extraction in the Evaluation_Criteria sheet? That will help our PM team evaluate results side-by-side with internal tooling.

If those items are OK, procurement will ask for a short SOW + a PO estimate. I've CC'd Tom since he'll coordinate the technical side.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Liu

Enterprise Bank

Hi Sarah — great notes, and all reasonable. Quick answers inline and an updated ask: 

- SSO / KMS: Yes — we support Azure AD for SSO and can integrate with your KMS for the POC. We'll need a short technical onboarding (service account + temporary KMS creds) and Dylan can validate in the test env.
- Data sample: 2,500 de-identified tickets is fine. We'll run the evals on that subset — please let us know how you'd like to transfer (S3 presigned URL, secure upload to our intake portal, or SFTP).
- Evaluation metrics: we'll add precision/recall for entity extraction to the Evaluation_Criteria.xlsx and include per-prompt examples.

I've attached an Integration_Checklist.docx that outlines the minimal technical pieces we'll need for Week 1. Also attached an updated POC_SOW_v1 with a slightly adjusted timeline if we need extra time for KMS onboarding.

Proposed start date: Mon, Mar 30 (gives 1 week for paperwork & access). If you prefer earlier, we can try to compress to start next Monday (Mar 23) but that'll require faster procurement turnaround.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Send updated SOW (attached) and DocuSign link for signature once you confirm
- Dylan will send the technical kickoff invite and SSO/KMS checklist follow-up

Thanks — I'll wait for confirmation on sample transfer method and which start date you prefer.

Best,
Camila
